subject: Fixing the variance of an exogenous variable

messages.author: 423ad55c6f3b032d
messages.subject: Fixing the variance of an exogenous variable
parts:
Hi,


I am new to SEM but I was wondering what fixing the variance of an exogenous variable was really doing in Lavaan ? Is it fixing the the variance of the variable or of the error ?

By fixing the variance I mean doing this:

exovar1 ~~ 1*exovar1

I have scaled all my exogenous variable to have variance of 1 beforehand..

Thank you !

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Fixing the variance of an exogenous variable
parts: If the variable is not dependent, then you are fixing the (total) error variance. If the variable is dependent, then you are fixing the residual variance. (It is the residual variance in either case because, with no predictors, residual variance = total variance.)
